text: As I move from the bright, structured stillness of the hallway into this vibrant exhibition space alive with ideas—R+D gleaming on the wall—I am struck by a gentle thrill of curiosity. I feel as if I am on the threshold between contemplation and innovation, held in a moment where glass and words, light and color, invite me to question and discover anew. What more might I learn if I linger here, open to what unfolds?
